purpose: Gate C candidate screening. This registry records input semantics and disqualifications before an adapter is written. It is not a result table or a claim that any listed repository is integrated.
g2_i_public_inputs: public inspection atlas (coarse regions or full cells as a declared ablation)
public mission sector and safe transit graph
public starts and vehicle self state
g2_i_forbidden_inputs: private city mesh, rendered depth, or evaluator ray results

candidates.g2_i_mapping: Direct only as a routing implementation: public full-atlas cells are nodes, represented area is a public weight, and the public safe-transit graph supplies travel costs.
candidates.integration_status: development L0 closed; no formal score
candidates.disposition: Keep as an external-solver routing baseline. It is not an externally maintained three-dimensional search method.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: Direct for ordering only: the locked source-cost formula receives each drone's target-independent public sector cells. The public mission sector supplies the four-drone partition; shared CF2X execution supplies motion and OBSERVE.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: native MATLAB or Octave source-equivalence fixture
candidates.license_status: verified MIT at the locked commit
candidates.integration_status: source-locked Python translation with a three-ancestor current-boundary L0 calibration panel; no native upstream runtime, upstream multi-UAV allocation, or CF2X L1 execution
candidates.disposition: Retain as the first semantically compatible external 3-D inspection-ordering candidate. Its L0 panel remains calibration-only and cannot close Gate C; native-source equivalence and the public three-ancestor CF2X L1 panel are still required.

required_upstream_inputs: dense depth or point-cloud ray observations
frontier candidates with clearance and visibility support
candidates.g2_i_mapping: No semantics-preserving mapping. G2-I exposes target-agnostic inspection cells and coarse local occupancy, not the ray-built free-space observations that FUEL uses to create and reject frontiers.
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I. It remains a future G1-U exploration candidate only if a separately declared public sensor-stream profile is released.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: No direct mapping demonstrated. Treating full public cells as a coverage map would be a new derived implementation, not a locked upstream integration.
candidates.license_status: GitHub root metadata had no SPDX license at screening time
candidates.disposition: Exclude until the upstream license and a semantics-preserving public-input adapter are independently verified.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: No direct mapping demonstrated. Its frontier pipeline has different observation semantics from a predeclared public inspection atlas.
candidates.license_status: screening found mixed package notices and no verified root closure
candidates.disposition: Exclude from the formal candidate set; do not infer a license from a README or substitute private geometry.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: Only a declared two-dimensional transfer diagnostic is possible; a projection loses the three-dimensional inspection orientation and cannot claim comparable geometry-search performance.
candidates.disposition: Retain only in a compatibility appendix. It cannot close Gate C or join the G2-I main table.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: It can be a low-level trajectory-planning control comparison only after a separately audited public map profile exists. It does not select inspection regions or search for targets.
candidates.disposition: Exclude as a substantive search method; do not count a shared controller component as a baseline.

candidates.g2_i_mapping: The public atlas can supply inspection-cell locations, but not its wind-farm terrain/energy-matrix semantics or dynamic-base decision variables. Replacing those parts would create a benchmark-owned derivative rather than run the locked upstream method.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: public terrain and energy-cost semantics equivalent to the upstream model
candidates.license_status: MIT stated by repository; upstream README calls the paper a submitted manuscript
candidates.disposition: Do not integrate now. It is useful evidence that inspection routing exists, but not a validated G2-I external baseline.

required_upstream_inputs: voxel-graph motion primitives and convex-hull trajectory environment
candidates.g2_i_mapping: No semantics-preserving mapping. HighStar's published planner creates viewpoints from online unknown/free-space geometry, whereas G2-I publishes an inspection atlas and does not expose the ray-built map required to form those frontiers.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: online ray-built free-space and unknown-space map
candidates.license_status: no root SPDX license found in the locked upstream tree
candidates.integration_status: local source and README screened only
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I. Retain as a future G1-U candidate only if a separate public sensor-stream profile is frozen.

required_upstream_inputs: ROS 1 vehicle state and trajectory environment
candidates.g2_i_mapping: No direct mapping demonstrated. Supplying the private city mesh or rendered LiDAR would violate G2-I information boundaries; deriving EPIC's mapping pipeline from atlas cells would replace its exploration core.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: private city geometry or rendered sensor data
candidates.license_status: verified GPL; any future execution requires an isolated process or container
candidates.integration_status: local source and paper metadata screened only
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I and do not implement an adapter. It is relevant only to a separately specified G1-U LiDAR exploration track.

candidates.task_class: three-dimensional prior-mesh coverage planning for a ground robot
required_upstream_inputs: complete and target three-dimensional mesh models
ground-robot body geometry and reachable start point
sensor recording plugin and accumulated reconstruction
candidates.g2_i_mapping: The task is academically close but not directly compatible. Converting the atlas into complete/target mesh models would invent a new input representation, and its ground-robot navigation and reconstruction loop are not the shared CF2X flight/OBSERVE contract.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: public complete and target mesh models
candidates.license_status: verified MIT at the locked upstream revision
candidates.integration_status: README, source contract, and paper metadata screened only
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I. Cite as related prior-mesh inspection work, not as a runnable CF2X baseline.

required_upstream_inputs: RGB images, depth images, and camera intrinsics
open-vocabulary semantic encoder and pretrained model weights
candidates.g2_i_mapping: No G2-I geometry mapping. RayFronts uses RGB/depth-derived semantic ray frontiers and text prompts to reduce a semantic search volume; the geometry-search track deliberately withholds these modalities and target semantics.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: semantic target prompt and pretrained perception model
candidates.license_status: MIT root license observed in the local source snapshot; exact upstream revision and model/dependency provenance are not locked
candidates.integration_status: local README and source contract screened only
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I and Gate C. It is a relevant future perception-search candidate only after a separately frozen RGB-D profile and model-license audit.

candidates.license: BSD-3-Clause root; multi-repository dependency closure unverified
required_upstream_inputs: Isaac Sim sensor streams through AirStack
global waypoint overwrite interface and local collision-avoidance stack
optional language-vision model and downloaded pretrained weights
candidates.g2_i_mapping: No semantics-preserving G2-I mapping. RAVEN's published system makes global semantic plans from camera-derived memory and optionally a language-vision model. Giving it these inputs would create a different perception-search task; removing them would remove its method core.
missing_or_forbidden_inputs: semantic prompt, semantic memory, and pretrained model weights
AirStack/RayFronts dependency and container provenance closure
candidates.license_status: BSD-3-Clause root license observed in the local source snapshot; recursive submodules and pretrained model licenses are not closed
candidates.integration_status: local README and source contract screened only
candidates.disposition: Exclude from G2-I and Gate C. Cite it as an ICRA 2026 perception-navigation reference; evaluate it only in a separately declared perception-search track.
